decision: The eight captured class bytes are real in this test runner but do not cover the exact official worker/runtime boundary. They cannot be adopted as the complete expected manifest.

source_bound_gaps.evidence: The captured AllocationRunner class is accompanied by separately compiled IndustrialWasteV2AllocationInput, IndustrialWasteV2QuietCheckpointObservation, IndustrialWasteV2AllocationReplay and IndustrialWasteV2AllocationTrace declarations used by the runner; none appears in the eight rows.
The worker uses GameSimulator, AIPlayer, DecisionResponder, CardAdvisorRegistry and other engine components whose loaded bytes and code sources are outside the eight rows.

Source pins for gradlew/scripts/test-class/scripts/gradle-locked and Python validation are checked, but the code explicitly says source checks do not establish loaded JVM identity; no accepted expected loaded-byte manifest or prepared-worker attestation is verified.
Official worker admits and loops allocations via the Python authority; it does not call IndustrialWasteV2LoadedJvmIdentity.verify against an accepted expected manifest at prepared-worker start.

next_executable_gate: Prospectively define the complete class/code-source boundary, bind an independently reviewed expected manifest into published runtime authority, then verify actual loaded bytes in the prepared worker before any admission/initialization; qualify fail-closed mismatches and combined receiving. Preserve original eight-row capture as candidate data only.
independent_review: NOT_PERFORMED; author review cannot satisfy the frozen independent acceptance requirement
